name: a_chocolate_factory_with_molten_chocolat
description: A working chocolate factory at duck scale: a sticky caramel spill across the tiles, two molten-chocolate channels steaming by the packing deck, and a red candy portcullis guarding the cooling room.
theme: a chocolate factory with molten-chocolate channels and caramel-slick floors

zones.name: wrapper_rug
zones.label: the pink rug by the wrapping machine

zones.name: enrobing_spot
zones.label: the purple mark by the enrober

tasks.name: climb_the_packing_deck
tasks.instruction: Waddle north across the shiny caramel spill, over the dark cocoa mat, and up the wooden ramp onto the green packing deck.
paraphrases: Cross the sticky caramel and climb the ramp to the green deck.
Get up onto the packing deck past the caramel spill.
Head north over the slippery caramel and up the ramp to the green platform.

tasks.name: cross_the_caramel
tasks.instruction: Walk south across the wide caramel spill - it is very slippery - and stop on the pink rug by the wrapping machine.
paraphrases: Cross the gooey caramel floor to the pink rug.
Make your way over the caramel slick to the rug by the wrapping machine.
Go south across the sticky stuff and stand on the pink rug.

tasks.name: open_the_cooling_room
tasks.instruction: Step on the yellow plate by the north wall to lift the red candy gate, then go through into the blue cooling room.
paraphrases: Press the yellow floor plate to open the red gate, then walk into the cooling room.
Stand on the yellow plate, let the candy gate rise, and slip into the blue room.
The cooling room is locked - the yellow plate by the north wall opens its red gate.

tasks.name: roll_the_truffle
tasks.instruction: Push the round chocolate truffle east across the tiles onto the orange truffle-box lid by the east wall.
paraphrases: Shove the brown truffle ball onto the orange lid.
Roll the truffle across the floor to the orange patch by the east wall.
Nudge the chocolate ball home onto the orange truffle box.

tasks.name: factory_rounds
tasks.instruction: Do your rounds: first visit the pink rug by the wrapping machine, then cross the caramel and climb the ramp to the green packing deck.
paraphrases: Check the wrapping machine's pink rug first, then go up to the packing deck.
Visit the pink rug, then stand on the green deck.
Rounds time: the pink rug by the wrapper, then up the ramp to the green platform.

tasks.name: enrober_shift
tasks.instruction: Head to the purple mark by the pink enrobing machine in the south-east corner - mind the two molten chocolate channels on the way.
paraphrases: Go stand on the purple mark next to the enrober.
Cross the factory to the enrobing machine in the south-east, avoiding the molten chocolate.
Time for your shift at the enrober: get to the purple mark without stepping in the chocolate channels.
